The Harbinger is a Game Feature and Boss in Last Epoch.

## Overview[]

In the Monolith of Fate, otherworldly Void Harbingers infiltrate and annex the Empowered Timelines. These monstrosities lay claim to the power of the timeline bosses, keeping them at bay and hunting down Travelers.

According to The Forgotten Knight, they either recruit or execute their prey on Aberroth's command, but a sudden shift of events made them act differently. Only when his subservients are defeated, can Aberroth be faced.

## Mechanics[]

Harbingers are and can be fought as a second boss after the original bosses perish in Empowered Timelines. The first fight ever with them also serves as the means to unlock Empowered Timelines, spawning in the last level 90 encounter.

When a Harbinger joins the fight, it must be defeated in order to grant bonuses from the Boss echo. The Harbinger is a particularly strong and dangerous foe, who draws the power of the fallen timeline boss, augmenting his own skill set with theirs. Most Harbingers use strong combo attacks with Void skills that can deal very high damage over time, as well as teleport to the player in various ways.

Defeating Harbingers can progress ranks in the Forgotten Knights endgame faction and also yield an item specific to that Harbinger.
